summary: -i is parsed into iterations and bounds the measured loop that calls spmvCpu. Rank 0's boundaries begin at 0 and end at numRows; intermediate boundaries are generated in rank order from the prior boundary, so adjacent local ranges cover every row without gaps. Compiled timed code shows the outer iteration back edge plus per-row CSR loads, multiplication/addition, output stores, and row traversal. No omitted or hoisted timed iterations identified.

source_evidence.claim: -i sets iterations. The boundary array is explicitly initialized with 0 and numRows, and intermediate entries split from the preceding boundary; each rank receives its adjacent range and corresponding CSR data. The timed loop calls spmvCpu iterations times, and each call traverses CSR row intervals and stores output rows.

compiled_evidence.claim: The timed block starts at MPI_Wtime and contains row and CSR-entry loops with column/value/vector loads, multiply/add accumulation, output stores, and an iteration-counter increment/compare branching back. The separate compiled spmvCpu body confirms these CSR operations and row/nonzero back edges.
